verdict.rationale: Superpowers does not document its own way to choose between a project-local install committed with the repo and a user-global install. Its docs say everything ships through each harness's own install mechanism, so install scope is a host-platform capability. The project-local copy into ./.claude/skills/ was done with the separate `npx skills` installer, and the `~/.agents/skills/` path is a runtime convention, not a Superpowers scope option.
